_comment: Corpus cases where CoverageInformationValidator and the official HL7 validator disagree on purpose or by a known bug. 'ours' is our verdict. Each entry is either a deliberate leniency or strictness recorded in DECISIONS.md ('Differential testing against the official validator') or an open bug issue. Do not add an entry to make a new disagreement pass without one of those. An entry with 'warning' is a leniency we must still report as a WARNING at that path.

legacy-identifier.why: Deliberate leniency: the HL7 reference implementation sends the pre-2.x 'identifier' sub-extension in place of coverage-assertion-id. We report it as a WARNING, not an ERROR. DECISIONS.md.

q4-auth-needed-with-withpa.why: Deliberate: crd-ci-q4's FHIRPath ('A and B implies C') is empty, so failing, whenever pa-needed is not satisfied, which forbids withpa everywhere. We check the invariant's text, which only forbids withpa after satisfied or no-auth. DECISIONS.md.

type-coverage-not-coverage.why: Deliberate strictness: the coverage valueReference must target a Coverage. The official validator does not check the type of an unresolved literal reference; 'Patient/pat-1' names a Patient, so we reject it. DECISIONS.md.

unknown-ri-coverage-info.why: Deliberate leniency (owner decision on #125): the HL7 reference implementation sends 'coverageInfo', a relative url the profile does not define. The official validator fails it; we report it as a WARNING, not an ERROR, like the legacy 'identifier', so reference server responses are not flagged as errors. DECISIONS.md.
